video_title: PABLO PRIGIONI en DOBLE DOBLE: "HAY QUE ADAPTARSE A WEMBY"

quotes.speaker: Pablo Prigioni
quotes.summary_phrase: Adapting to Victor Wembanyama's unique defensive and offensive impact
quotes.excerpt: I would say that more than having Wembanyama stoppers, I think there is to adapt to play against Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: I would say that more than having Wembanyama stoppers, I think there is to adapt to play against Wembanyama. Obviously, he has many offensive resources and I think he is a player who will continue improving. But I think all the players have to adapt to play against him because there are no others like him. His ability to be in the paint and change shots is unique. We thought that Rudy Gobert was the elite and he was and he is, but this kid is something else. After having played a playoff series with him, I tell you that he changes a lot the way you have to attack San Antonio now.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo te diría que más que tener Wemby stoppers, creo que hay que adaptarse a jugar contra Wemby. Obviamente él ofensivamente tiene muchos recursos y creo que es un jugador que va a seguir mejorando. Pero creo que todos los jugadores se tienen que adaptar a jugar contra él porque no hay otros como él. Su capacidad para estar en la pintura y cambiar tiros es única. Nosotros pensábamos que Rudy era el elite y lo fue y lo es, pero este chico es algo más. Después de haber jugado una serie de playoffs con él, te digo que él cambia mucho la manera en que hay que atacar a San Antonio ahora.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Prigioni
quotes.summary_phrase: The intensity of the Oklahoma City Thunder vs. San Antonio Spurs series
quotes.excerpt: The intensity of that series, I think it took its toll on San Antonio.
quotes.quote: The intensity of that series, I think it took its toll on San Antonio, because perhaps they thought that beating the champion put them in a mental point where I think New York took advantage of that. New York arrived very fresh, but that series was extraordinary. Again, I think Wembanyama had a very big impact there, but not only him, but the San Antonio guards. They all played at a very high level, I think they gave the maximum in that series.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: La intensidad de esa serie, creo que le pasó factura a San Antonio, porque quizás pensaron que bueno, que ya habían, no que ya eran campeones, pero pensar que ganarle al campeón los puso, no sé, mentalmente en un punto donde creo que se aprovechó Nueva York de eso. Nueva York llegó muy fresco, pero esa serie no, fue extraordinaria. De nuevo, creo que Wemby ahí tuvo un impacto muy grande, pero no solo él, sino los guardias de San Antonio, jugaron todos a un nivel altísimo, creo que dieron el máximo en esa serie.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Prigioni
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's leadership in bringing teammates to France
quotes.excerpt: The management of Rudy for to bring all his teammates to France was extraordinary.
quotes.quote: The management of Rudy for to bring all his teammates to France was extraordinary. The truth is that you have to take your hat off. And also the commitment of the kids to say 'let's go', because you see, there are many and all have their things, their families, their girlfriends, their wives, and that everyone has found that window to say 'let's all go', has been extraordinary. It is not seen much, it is not that we see it constantly, so we take our hat off to Rudy and I think that part of creating a team is creating a group.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: La gestión de Rudy para llevar a todos sus compañeros a Francia fue extraordinaria. La verdad que hay que sacarse el sombrero. Y también el compromiso de los chicos de decir 'vamos', porque viste, son muchos y todos tienen sus cosas, sus familias, sus novias, sus mujeres y que todos hayan encontrado esa ventanita para decir 'vamos todos', ha sido extraordinaria. No se ve mucho, no es que lo vemos constantemente, así que nos sacamos el sombrero con Rudy y creo que parte de crear un equipo es crear un grupo.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Prigioni
quotes.summary_phrase: Surprise at Jaylen Brown's departure from the Boston Celtics
quotes.excerpt: What surprised me most was the departure of Brown from Boston, I did not imagine that.
quotes.quote: What surprised me most was the departure of Brown from Boston, I did not imagine that he could leave. I am not an expert in salary issues and to see if they can pay him or not, I am not an expert in that. Being a core player together with Tatum, it surprised me that one of the two could leave. After where it fell and how they were armed around, that no, because in the end, LeBron was a free agent and could make his own decisions and decide where he wanted to go.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Lo que más me sorprendió fue la salida de Brown de Boston, no imaginaba que podía salir. Tampoco soy un experto en temas salariales y ver si le pueden pagar, no le pueden pagar, no soy experto en eso. Siendo un core del equipo junto con Tatum, me sorprendió que uno de los dos pudiera salir. Después donde cayó y cómo se armaron alrededor, eso no, porque al final, LeBron era agente libre, podía tomar sus propias decisiones y decidir dónde querer ir.
